label: Nanning: Yongning into Nanning
why: Yongning (ygi), a district of Nanning south of the centre, is a zone of its own at 0.33M (0.19M plan, a fifth of China's 1M floor); 53% of its commutes cross its line, 103,000 a day with Nanning. A player on the board (1795455528-5b8a2b8e) also found the split odd. ygi is retired into Nanning's metro (nag).
